Ranks Montgomery census tracts by the raw increase in code violations from 2024 to 2025, joining per-year counts to tract names and keeping geoid last for mapping.
sql:
WITH yearly AS (
  SELECT geoid,
         MAX(CASE WHEN grp = '2024' THEN n END) AS violations_2024,
         MAX(CASE WHEN grp = '2025' THEN n END) AS violations_2025
  FROM fw_pg.tract_counts
  WHERE run_id = 'r_20261024_cf7e8c'
    AND source = 'm1_city'
    AND grp IN ('2024','2025')
  GROUP BY geoid
)
SELECT t.name AS tract_name,
       (COALESCE(y.violations_2025, 0) - COALESCE(y.violations_2024, 0)) AS increase_in_code_violations,
       COALESCE(y.violations_2024, 0) AS code_violations_2024,
       COALESCE(y.violations_2025, 0) AS code_violations_2025,
       t.geoid
FROM fw_pg.tracts t
LEFT JOIN yearly y ON t.geoid = y.geoid
ORDER BY increase_in_code_violations DESC NULLS LAST, tract_name ASC
LIMIT 200

  SELECT CAST(TRIM(geoid) AS STRING) AS geoid,
         MAX(CASE WHEN grp = '2024' THEN n END) AS violations_2024,
         MAX(CASE WHEN grp = '2025' THEN n END) AS violations_2025
  FROM fw_pg.tract_counts
  WHERE run_id = 'r_20261024_cf7e8c'
    AND source = 'm1_city'
    AND grp IN ('2024','2025')
  GROUP BY CAST(TRIM(geoid) AS STRING)
)
SELECT t.name AS tract_name,
       (COALESCE(y.violations_2025, 0) - COALESCE(y.violations_2024, 0)) AS increase_in_code_violations,
       COALESCE(y.violations_2024, 0) AS code_violations_2024,
       COALESCE(y.violations_2025, 0) AS code_violations_2025,
       t.geoid
FROM fw_pg.tracts t
LEFT JOIN yearly y ON CAST(TRIM(t.geoid) AS STRING) = y.geoid
ORDER BY increase_in_code_violations DESC NULLS LAST, tract_name ASC
LIMIT 200
